title: Card
description: The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item.
when: Group the content of a page in cards; nested facts in TILE.
a11y: With onClick the card is a button for keyboards and screen readers (role="button", tab order, Enter / Space, focus ring); active becomes aria-pressed. Never a div with onClick (semi-lint click-target).
A card that opens another page puts a next/link on its title instead of onClick.
notes: It pads itself: padding="card" (p-card, default), "panel" (p-card sm:p-panel) or "none" for an image or table to the edge. Never tighter than p-card (card-padding); a p-* in className replaces the default.
Pass padding and layout only: no bg-* or shadow-* on <Card> (card-class-override).
